en.bdb: The claim of Koka, the male nurse

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਵੰਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਧਾਤੂ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: paaras va(n)see hoi kai sabhanaa dhaatoo mel mila(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Being of a noble family, the philosopher's stone meets all the metals (and makes them gold).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਧਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan vaas subhaau hai afal safal vich vaas dhara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The nature of the sandal is fragrant and it makes all fruitless as well as fruitful trees fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਤਰੰਗੀ ਗੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਨਦੀਆ ਨਾਲੇ ਗੰਗ ਹੋਵੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: lakh tara(n)gee ga(n)g hoi nadheeaa naale ga(n)g hova(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The Ganges is formeds of many tributaries but meeting the Ganges they all become Ganges.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਵਾ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਆਲਿਆ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਕੋਕਾ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhaavaa dhudh peeaaliaa paatisaahaa kokaa bhaava(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Koka's claim of having served as the milk giver to the king is liked by the king

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੂਣ ਖਾਇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਦਾ ਕੋਕਾ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: loon khai paatisaeh dhaa kokaa chaakar hoi vala(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: And Koka also having eaten the salt of the royal household hovers around the king to serve him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵੰਸੀ ਪਰਮਹੰਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਹੰਸ ਵੰਸੁ ਨਿਬਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur va(n)see paramaha(n)s gur sikh ha(n)s va(n)s nibaha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is of the lineage of the swans of high order and the Sikhs of the Guru also abide by the tradition of the swan family.
Both follow the path shown by their forefathers.
